board_identity: THE DIAMONDEDGE PICK — one pick per game
unified_rule: ONE pick per game: (1) if the champion has a qualifying PLAY on the game (clears its +EV gate) that IS the pick; (2) else if the v4 model grid has a playable lean (clears the +EV gate + 0.01 conviction floor) that is the pick; (3) else the game shows its best lean as a PASS (never a bet). One 0-5 score + star ladder (frozen v3.2 percentile, shared by both sources); one record, graded once per game against finals. `source` is diagnostic only — the UI renders champion- and model-sourced picks identically.
score_reference_version: v3.2 (Leon, 2026-07-09: TRUE continuous percentile score — no band quantization; stars = floor bands of the score)

star_cutoffs.version: v3.2 (Leon, 2026-07-09: TRUE continuous percentile score — no band quantization; stars = floor bands of the score)
star_cutoffs.bands: floor bands of the continuous v3.2 score: 2.00-2.99 -> 2*, 3.00-3.99 -> 3*, 4.00-4.99 -> 4*; 1* = non-playable; 5* = BH-reserved
star_cutoffs.basis: v3.2: the percentile normalization moved INTO the score (2.0 + 3.0 * season strength percentile, frozen reference in `score_reference`), so the star cutoffs are plain floor bands — each playable tier is ~a third of the season playable percentile, and a mid-strength pick CAN land 3* (the v3.1 band-quantization gap is fixed). The -EV floor is hard: non-playable rows stay 1* regardless of score.

performance_claim: NONE — the champion stream carries the only live record; the model fills are rated honestly lower. No edge is claimed.
positioning: THE DIAMONDEDGE PICK (Leon, 2026-07-20): one pick per game, one score, one star ladder, one record. The champion's qualifying plays lead; the v4 model fills quiet-champion games so the board is never empty. champion_v2 and the sealed research walk are untouched.

record.note: ONE record over the unified product: exactly one graded pick per (date, game_pk) — champion-sourced picks have priority, model leans fill games the champion did not play. by_source is DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; the champion subset equals the champion headline exactly, the model subset is the honest fill, and the two sum to overall. No pick is counted twice.
